name: Wanderer-Mike
text:
I was a participant at Partha’s NLP Practitioner Course in October 2026 at IQCBS. It’s very difficult to write a recommendation for him, because one needs to experience Partha. He is brilliant but humble, disciplined but flexible, demanding but kind. He walks the talk. And his interventions are very deep.

His grasp of complex topics and the simplicity of his explanations, stood out for me. His style of facilitation is participative, and he doesn’t come across as being a typical “teacher.” He makes sure to involve all participants, whether virtual or in-person. And he was flexible in allowing us to discover and experiment with concepts for ourselves. Time stands still when you are with Partha.

Partha leads with curiosity. He is genuinely interested in your life story. And then Partha transforms you. You will never be the same again. Because he makes sure that you not only learn but that you become a better human being.

I’m happy that he chose the name NLP Gurukul for the IQCBS NLP practice because Partha is truly a Guru.

If you ever get the chance, experience Partha, because he will change your life for the better.

name: Joyita Dutta
text:
Mr. Partha Roy’s guidance goes far beyond conventional coaching. At a deeper, mission level, he has been my Guru—aligning my inner growth with a higher sense of purpose and meaning. My NLP journey began under his mentorship, and completing the NLP Master’s Program with him has been a profoundly transformative experience, both personally and professionally.
As a Sustainable Shift Coach and NLP Master Trainer, Mr. Roy brings exceptional depth, clarity, and integrity to his work. His expertise across modalities such as Metaphors of Movement, Integral Eye Movement Therapy, Hypnotherapy, and Social Panorama is complemented by his rare ability to make complex frameworks deeply experiential and practical. Each session evolved into a journey of self-awareness, responsibility, and lasting change.
What truly distinguishes him is his commitment to facilitating sustainable shifts rather than momentary motivation. The positive changes I have experienced in my mindset, emotional balance, and decision-making have been enduring and continue to support my growth. His role as the Ambassador of India for the Society of Mental Space Psychology reflects both his mastery and his contribution to the broader field of human transformation.
I remain deeply grateful for his mentorship, wisdom, and compassionate leadership. Learning under his guidance has been a privilege, and his influence will continue to illuminate my journey ahead.

name: Aparna Ghosh
text:
Partho Roy's NLP trainings with IQCBS have been a game-changer for me, taking me from beginner to NLP Master’s. His empathetic approach made the learning transformative.
I have had a great experience attending the NLP Masters (residential) - initially I was unsure if it would be useful, but staying on-site made all the difference. It wasn't easy accommodating the time however after 2 days in, I realised how crucial it was for intense learning . Partha da even sweats the small stuff to make us comfy, felt super special .
Highly recommend him for NLP and personal transformation.

name: Jyoti Bagaria
text:
I have completed multiple NLP trainings with Partho Roy from IQCBS, starting completely from scratch and progressing all the way to my NLP Master’s. Each program was better than the previous one, with the Master’s being truly exceptional. The residential format made it an experience I will cherish forever.

Partho’s training style is deeply empathetic and experiential. He gives individual attention to every participant, constantly gauging understanding through his sharp NLP observation, meaningful pauses, and timely interventions. No one is ever left behind. His care extends well beyond the classroom, making the learning environment safe, supportive, and transformative.

I would highly recommend Partho Roy to anyone serious about learning NLP or personal transformation.

— Jyoti Bagaria, ICF PCC Life Coach & Dual Master Practitioner in NLP
